title: Baba Mai Teri Zainab
body:
haye ali haye haye zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se jab hyder e safdar ka janaza utha
sun ke hasnain bhi rone lage zainab ki sada
baba mere baba mai teri zainab hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri baar kaleje se lagao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
tod kar bande kafan mujhko bulao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
kya gawara hai tumhe sar se hataun chadar
bolo kyun chup ho padar
mujhse baatein karo yun moo na chupao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai bhala kaise judaai ka uthaungi ye gham
aap ko maa ki qasam
doosri baar yateemi se bachao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm tha aap ka zainab se chupa kar rakhna
kuch na isay kehna
ab to jaate huwe wo zakhm dikhao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaun jannat ke manga kar mujhe ab dega libaas
eid bhi aagayi paas
ab mai zid kis se karungi ye batao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne amma ki shahadat pe tasalli di thi
abhi zinda hai ali
ab mujhe kaun sambhalega batao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha milne ke liye tum se kabhi aa na sake
qabr par jaa na sake
is qadar door to basti na basao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad bhi is tarha wafadaar rahe
sang baari na kare
kufiyon se zara kehte huwe jao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ko is ne takallum na di awaaz kabhi
sirf ashoor ko di
mai hoon muhskil mein najaf chod ke aao baba
baba mai teri zainab hoon
aakhri baar kaleje se...
author: Mir Takallum
